title: The Tactical Battle
subtitle: One goal. Ninety minutes of chess.

events.note: Northbridge push a #10 between Riverside's lines

key_moments.headline: Northbridge push a #10 between Riverside's lines
Riverside's best chance flashes wide on the counter

ground_truth.story: Riverside's 5-4-1 block frustrates Northbridge until a 55th-minute shift to a 4-2-3-1 puts a playmaker between the lines; the goal comes from that zone.
